source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of alcohols (PDF 92-95).

blocks.text: Alcohols poori tarah jal kar carbon dioxide aur paani dete hain: CH3CH2OH + 3O2 -> 2CO2 + 3H2O, delta Hc = -1367 kJ/mol. Reaction bohat exothermic hai, isi liye kuch mulkon mein petrol ki jagah ethanol use hota hai.

-OH group ki jagah halogen aa kar halogenoalkane banta hai, maslan CH3CH2OH + HCl -> CH3CH2Cl + H2O (ZnCl2 catalyst); doosre reagents (SOCl2, PCl3, PCl5, tezaab ke saath KBr) topic 21.1 mein diye gaye.

Sodium jaisi reactive dhaat hydroxyl group ka O-H bond torti hai: hydrogen gas nikalti aur aik base, alkoxide, banta hai: 2CH3CH2OH + 2Na -> 2CH3CH2ONa + H2. Reaction sodium aur paani se kam shiddat wala hai, aur lambi hydrocarbon zanjeer wale alcohols ke liye aur bhi kam. Yeh -OH group ka test hai: hydrogen ke bulbule batate hain ke group maujood hai. Zaid ethanol urane par safaid qalmi sodium ethoxide bachta hai. Phenolphthalein maujood ho to gulabi rang ethanol ke saath dheere lekin paani ke saath fauran aata hai, jo dikhata hai ke ethanol aahista react karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Propan-1-ol ka SOCl2 se reaction likhein.
PCl3 aur PCl5 ke propan-1-ol se reactions ke mua'adlat likhein.
blocks.explanation: 3CH3CH2CH2OH + PCl3 -> 3CH3CH2CH2Cl + H3PO3; CH3CH2CH2OH + PCl5 -> CH3CH2CH2Cl + POCl3 + HCl.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol KBr se kaise react karta hai? Mua'adla dein.
blocks.explanation: Garhe sulphuric acid ke saath, jo flask mein HBr banata hai: CH3CH2OH + KBr + H2SO4 -> CH3CH2Br + KHSO4 + H2O.

blocks.text: Primary alcohols pehle aldehydes aur phir carboxylic acids mein oxidise hote hain; secondary alcohols sirf ketones mein; tertiary alcohols oxidise nahi hote. Oxidising agents mein tezaabi potassium dichromate(VI), K2Cr2O7, aur tezaabi KMnO4 shamil hain. Dichromate narangi hai: alcohol oxidise hone par narangi Cr2O7 2- ions hare Cr3+ ions mein reduce hote hain. Aldehyde ko bante hi distil kar ke nikalne se reaction aldehyde par rukta; reflux par garam karne se carboxylic acid tak jata hai.

items: CH3CH2OH + [O] -> CH3CHO + H2O (ethanol se ethanal), phir CH3CHO + [O] -> CH3COOH.

blocks.alt: Oopar: primary ethanol pehle ethanal aur phir ethanoic acid mein oxidise; secondary propan-2-ol sirf propanone mein; tertiary 2-methylpropan-2-ol oxidise nahi hota. Neeche: garam karne ke baad tezaabi dichromate ki teen tubes: propan-1-ol aur propan-2-ol hari ho gayi; 2-methylpropan-2-ol narangi rehti hai.
blocks.caption: Primary, secondary aur tertiary alcohols ki oxidation aur dichromate test (kitab ke mua'adlon aur test tubes ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Oxidation -OH group ka hydrogen aur us ke carbon ka aik hydrogen hata deti hai. Tertiary alcohol ke us carbon par hydrogen nahi, is liye woh is tarah oxidise nahi ho sakta. Isi liye sirf primary aur secondary alcohols narangi dichromate mehlool ko hara karte hain, jis se unhein tertiary alcohols se alag pehchana jata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Potassium dichromate(VI) ke oxidising agent banne ke liye use khud reduce hona parta hai, aur is reduction ke liye hydrogen ions (H+) chahiye, jo tezaab deta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat: breathalyser
blocks.text: Sharab pee kar gaari chalana bohat khatarnak hai. Traffic officers driver ko check karne ke liye breathalyser use karte hain. Aik qism driver ki saans ke ethanol ko oxidise karti hai; oxidation electrons chhorti hai, aur banne wala bijli ka current alcohol ki miqdar ke tanasub mein hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Alcohols A (2-methylpropan-1-ol), B (2-methylpropan-2-ol) aur C (C4H10O ka isomer jis ki seedhi zanjeer ke C2 par OH) ko tezaabi dichromate ke saath reflux kiya jata hai. C ka naam batayein, aur A ke mukammal jalne ka mua'adla likhein.
Tezaabi KMnO4 se alcohol oxidise hone par rang mein kya tabdeeli dikhti hai?
blocks.explanation: Jamni se be-rang, kyunke jamni MnO4- taqreeban be-rang Mn2+ mein reduce hota hai.

blocks.prompt: A, B aur C ko tezaabi dichromate ke saath reflux karne ke organic products batayein (reaction na ho to NONE likhein).
blocks.explanation: A (primary): 2-methylpropanoic acid, (CH3)2CHCOOH (2-methylpropanal ke zariye). B (tertiary): NONE. C (secondary): butanone, CH3COCH2CH3.

blocks.text: Alcohols ko dehydrate kar ke alkenes banai ja sakti hain. Dehydration elimination ki aik qism hai jis mein paani ka molecule nikalta hai: CH3CH2OH -> CH2=CH2 + H2O (Al2O3, garmi). Doosre dehydrating agents garha sulphuric acid aur garha phosphoric acid hain.

blocks.alt: CH3CH2OH ke gird chaar dabbe: jalna, C2H5OH + 3O2 -> 2CO2 + 3H2O, delta H = -1367 kJ/mol; substitution, C2H5OH + HCl -> C2H5Cl + H2O ZnCl2 ke saath; sodium ke saath, 2C2H5OH + 2Na -> 2C2H5ONa + H2; dehydration, C2H5OH -> CH2=CH2 + H2O garam Al2O3 par ya garhe tezaabon se.
blocks.caption: Ethanol ka jalna, substitution, sodium se reaction aur dehydration (kitab ke mua'adlon ka asal khulasa).
blocks.long_description: Jalna poora molecule torta hai; substitution -OH group badalti hai; sodium sirf -OH group ka hydrogen badalta hai; dehydration H2O hata kar C=C double bond chhorti hai.

items: Jalta hai: ethanol ka delta Hc = -1367 kJ/mol; Na se alkoxide + H2 (-OH ka test).
Oxidation (K2Cr2O7/H+, narangi se hara): 1 -> aldehyde -> tezaab; 2 -> ketone; 3 nahi.
Dehydration (Al2O3 ya garha tezaab) se alkene.
